title: LLM-as-a-Verifier: A General-Purpose Verification Framework
authors_zh: Jacky Kwok、Shulu Li 等（机构：斯坦福大学、加州大学伯克利分校、NVIDIA Research）
paper_type_zh: 验证扩展与测试时排序研究
best_for_zh: 用昂贵 LLM 验证来选择或引导智能体轨迹的读者。
one_line: LLM-as-a-Verifier turns score-token distributions into continuous trajectory rewards and scales verification along granularity, repetition, and criteria.
LLM-as-a-Verifier 把评分 token 分布转为连续轨迹奖励，并沿粒度、重复和准则三个维度扩展验证。
why: It makes verifier capacity a measurable test-time scaling axis instead of treating judging as a fixed black-box step.
inclusion_reason: It explicitly scales verification quality and uses the resulting continuous signals for test-time candidate selection.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Test-time sampling creates many plausible agent trajectories, but a coarse language-model judge often assigns tied discrete scores. More candidates therefore increase verification cost without reliably improving the choice of trajectory.

This paper asks how verification itself should scale when it is the bottleneck in test-time search. It studies continuous trajectory comparison, repeated checks, and decomposed criteria as alternatives to treating one fixed judge call as sufficient.

测试时采样会产生许多看似合理的智能体轨迹，但粗粒度语言模型评判常给出并列的离散分数。因此，更多候选会增加验证成本，却未必更可靠地选出正确轨迹。

本文研究当验证成为测试时搜索瓶颈时，验证本身应如何扩展。它考察连续轨迹比较、重复检查和分解准则，而不是把一次固定评判调用视为充分条件。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Instead of decoding one score token, LLM-as-a-Verifier takes the expectation over an ordered score-token logit distribution. This yields a continuous reward and pairwise preference probability for trajectories without training a separate reward model.

The verifier can be made stronger by increasing score-token granularity, averaging repeated evaluations, and decomposing judgment into criteria. A pivot tournament then spends pairwise comparisons mainly on plausible leaders rather than all candidate pairs.

LLM-as-a-Verifier 不再解码一个分数 token，而是对有序评分 token 的 logit 分布取期望。它由此得到轨迹的连续奖励和成对偏好概率，无需训练独立奖励模型。

验证器可通过增加评分粒度、平均重复评估和把判断拆成多个准则而增强。随后枢轴锦标赛主要把成对比较花在有希望的领先候选上，而不是比较所有候选对。

title: Method
方法
html:
For each trajectory pair and criterion, the verifier reads score-tag logits and converts their full distribution into a normalized reward. Repeated calls and criteria are aggregated, then a Bradley–Terry preference probability compares candidates.

For N candidates, a ring pass removes positional bias and selects k pivots; only pivot-versus-pivot and non-pivot-versus-pivot pairs are then evaluated. This reduces comparison growth from O(N squared) to O(Nk) while retaining a continuous ranking signal.

对于每个轨迹对和准则，验证器读取评分标签 logit，并把完整分布转为归一化奖励。重复调用和多个准则被聚合后，再由 Bradley–Terry 偏好概率比较候选。

对 N 个候选，环形初筛消除位置偏差并选出 k 个枢轴；随后只评估枢轴间以及非枢轴对枢轴的组合。这将比较增长从 O(N 平方) 降为 O(Nk)，同时保留连续排序信号。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On Terminal-Bench V2 pairwise verification, accuracy rises from 73.1% at one score token to 77.5% at twenty tokens, from 74.7% at one repeat to 77.5% at sixteen repeats, and to 78.3% with three criteria.

The paper reports 86.5% on Terminal-Bench V2, 78.2% on SWE-Bench Verified, 87.4% on RoboRewardBench, and 73.3% on MedAgentBench. These results support verification scaling across agentic domains, but depend on verifier-model access and benchmark protocols.

在 Terminal-Bench V2 成对验证中，准确率从一个评分 token 的 73.1% 升至二十个 token 的 77.5%，从一次重复的 74.7% 升至十六次的 77.5%，三个准则时达到 78.3%。

论文报告 Terminal-Bench V2 为 86.5%、SWE-Bench Verified 为 78.2%、RoboRewardBench 为 87.4%、MedAgentBench 为 73.3%。这些结果支持跨智能体领域的验证扩展，但依赖验证模型访问和基准协议。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The new object is a scalable verification distribution rather than a fixed discrete judge score. It exposes separate knobs for resolution, variance reduction, and evaluation complexity, then connects them to a budgeted candidate-ranking algorithm.

This is not merely a better prompt for a judge: it changes the ranking contract and comparison schedule. Reuse should inspect logprob availability, criteria prompts, positional-bias handling, and whether added verifier calls improve the target task enough to justify their latency.

新的对象是可扩展的验证分布，而非固定离散评判分数。它暴露分辨率、方差降低和评估复杂度三个旋钮，并把它们连接到受预算约束的候选排序算法。

这不只是更好的评判提示：它改变排序契约和比较调度。复用应检查 logprob 可用性、准则提示、位置偏差处理，以及新增验证调用是否足以证明其延迟合理。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method depends on a capable verifier and, in its primary form, accessible score-token logprobs. More granularity, repetitions, and criteria improve judgment but add latency and may amplify shared prompt bias. Continuous scores are not ground truth, so unsafe or adversarial trajectories still require domain checks.
方法依赖有能力的验证器，并且其主要形式需要可访问的评分 token logprob。更多粒度、重复和准则能改善判断，却会增加延迟，也可能放大共享提示偏差。连续分数不是真实标签，因此不安全或对抗性轨迹仍需领域检查。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when candidate generation already has pass-at-k headroom but selection is the bottleneck. Record the verifier budget separately from generation, sweep granularity/repetition/criteria, and compare the pivot tournament with full round robin and a fixed judge. Treat score distributions and comparison provenance as deployable audit records.
当候选生成已有 pass-at-k 潜力而选择成为瓶颈时，可使用本文。应把验证预算与生成预算分开记录，扫描粒度、重复和准则，并把枢轴锦标赛同全循环比较和固定评判比较。把分数分布和比较来源当作可部署的审计记录。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The important scaling unit is verification quality, not only number of rollouts. Granularity combats ties, repetition combats variance, and decomposition combats criterion blind spots. The pivot tournament makes those knobs usable at larger pools. Check the end-to-end cost before interpreting a verifier accuracy gain as an agent-performance gain.
重要的扩展单位是验证质量，而不只是轨迹数量。粒度对抗并列，重复对抗方差，分解对抗准则盲点；枢轴锦标赛让这些旋钮可用于更大候选池。把验证准确率增益解释为智能体性能增益前，先检查端到端成本。
